source.snippet: I wish there was a tool that regularly nuked my Facebook history as well, from comments in random groups to likes across the site. I have no use for things I commented 10 years ago.

problem_statement: Users who want to regularly and automatically delete their old social media activity (comments, likes, posts) across platforms like Facebook lack a reliable, automated tool that works at scale across multiple platforms.
target_segment: Privacy-conscious individuals and professionals (lawyers, executives, job seekers) who want ongoing automated cleanup of their public social media history.
notes: Older signal (2019) but the pain is perennial and growing with AI-driven reputation research. Tools like TweetDelete exist for Twitter/X but cross-platform automated social history deletion remains underserved. Privacy-conscious professionals (legal, finance, political) represent a paying segment. Recurring subscription model fits. Weak buyer signal but strong structural demand.
